outcome: accuracy of MRI for evaluation of post-Caesarean uterine scar
prediction of scar dehiscence during repeat CS
cohort: 30 patients with a history of at least one previous CS who underwent pelvic MRI for assessment of uterine scar during a subsequent gestation
finding: MRI-derived parameters, particularly scar thickness and T2 SER, can be used to differentiate between normal and abnormal post-Caesarean uterine scars and predict scar dehiscence.
